MindTech Arena 2026 is a national-level student competition organized by the MindQuest Club of IIIT Kottayam as a flagship event under Aaroh 2026.

click here to join the whatsapp group for event updates

The event brings together technology, logical thinking, creativity, problem-solving and teamwork through three engaging rounds. Designed to be beginner-friendly while still challenging participants, MindTech Arena gives students an opportunity to test their technical fundamentals, develop innovative solutions and present their ideas before a panel of judges.

From quick-thinking challenges to solution building and final presentations, every round is designed to test a different aspect of a participant's ability to think, collaborate and innovate.

Eligibility:

  • Beginners are encouraged to participate.

  • Participants from different colleges can form a team.

  • Students from different branches, specializations or disciplines can form a team.

  • Mixed-year teams are allowed.

  • There is no compulsory senior–fresher combination.

Team Size

  • Each team can have 1–5 members.
  • Participants may register individually or as a team.
  • Inter-college teams are allowed.
  • Inter-specialization and interdisciplinary teams are allowed.
  • Each participant can be part of only one team.

Participation & Event Details:

  • Mode: Offline
  • Venue: Indian Institute of Information Technology (IIIT) Kottayam
  • Team Size: 1–5 Members
  • Organizer: MindQuest Club, IIIT Kottayam
  • Flagship Event: Aaroh 2026.

Why Participate?

  • Compete with students from different institutions.
  • Test your technical fundamentals and logical thinking.
  • Develop creative solutions to real-world problems.
  • Improve teamwork and communication.
  • Experience a multi-round competitive environment.
  • Showcase your ideas before judges.
  • Win cash prizes and earn recognition.
  • Receive participation certification.

Participation Guidelines:

  • Each participant may register with only one team.
  • All participant and team information must be accurate.
  • Teams must report to the venue according to the schedule communicated by the organizers.
  • Participants must follow the instructions provided before each round.
  • Participants must complete each round within the specified time.
  • Only resources and tools permitted by the organizers may be used during the respective rounds.
  • Event credits are exclusively part of the competition mechanism and do not represent academic or activity credits.
  • Participants are expected to maintain professional and respectful conduct throughout the event.

Rules:

  • Each participant can be part of only one registered team.
  • A team must have a minimum of 1 and maximum of 5 members.
  • Inter-college and inter-specialization teams are permitted.
  • Participants must provide genuine and accurate information during registration.
  • Any form of cheating, impersonation, plagiarism or unfair assistance may result in immediate disqualification.
  • Participants must follow all round-specific instructions and time limits.
  • Teams must not interfere with the event systems, judging process or participation of other teams.
  • Any external resources or tools used during a round must comply with the rules announced by the organizers.
  • The organizers reserve the right to disqualify teams that violate the event rules.
  • The decision of the judges regarding qualification, evaluation and winners will be final.
  • The organizers reserve the right to make reasonable changes to the event schedule or format. Any significant changes will be communicated to participants.
  • By participating in MindTech Arena 2026, all participants agree to abide by the rules and guidelines of the event.
